test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

(A) and was searching for them

(B) the grandmother couldn’t find

(C) all around the house

(D) placed them on her head

(E) her spectacles because she had
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Part (B) should come first** as it introduces the subject and what she couldn’t find, "the grandmother couldn’t find":

 
 
• "the grandmother couldn’t find"
 
 
 
• **Part (E) follows** to explain what she couldn’t find, "her spectacles because she had":
 
 
• "her spectacles because she had"
 
 
 
• **Part (D) follows** to give the reason why she couldn’t find them, "placed them on her head":
 
 
• "placed them on her head"
 
 
 
• **Part (A) comes next** to show the action taken due to not finding spectacles, "and was searching for them":
 
 
• "and was searching for them"
 
 
 
• **Part (C) comes last** to show where the search happened, "all around the house":
 
 
• "all around the house"
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **BEDAC**.

 

**Coherent sentence after rearrangement:**

"The grandmother couldn’t find her spectacles because she had placed them on her head and was searching for them all around the house."
